description: Defines classes, enums, and functions related to attributes used in Torch JIT IR, including attribute kinds, attribute values, and specific attribute classes like GraphAttr and GraphsAttr.

classes.name: AttributeValue
classes.description: Base class for attribute values, holding a name and virtual methods for cloning and retrieving the attribute kind.

classes.name: ScalarAttributeValue
classes.description: Template class for scalar attribute values of various types, derived from AttributeValue.

classes.name: VectorAttributeValue
classes.description: Template class for vector attribute values of various types, derived from AttributeValue.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Forward declaration for Graph class used in attribute classes.

classes.name: GraphAttr
classes.description: Attribute class for Graph objects, ensuring proper cloning via Graph::copy().

classes.name: GraphsAttr
classes.description: Attribute class for a vector of Graph objects.

classes.name: IRAttributeError
classes.description: Exception class for errors related to IR attributes, such as undefined or wrong type attributes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts AttributeKind enum to its string representation.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Virtual method to clone attribute values, overridden in derived classes.
